r1.mechanism: drain_outbox stages segment+extract per claimed job, then ONE ensure_grouped over the pass's atoms (group then complete); obsolete-revision skip, retract fast-path, poison guard, held-claim fairness, idempotency, worker call-shape preserved (2 additive report keys: group_calls, grouped_atoms)
r1.why: HolonStore._fold_state_for_add re-fetches ALL member TEXT + double digest per add_members call (O(N)/job, O(N^2)/drain). One call per 64-job pass amortizes the fold 64x.

r3.mechanism: ONE pooled immutable warmed matrix per filing generation (State.shared_hybrid under shared_lock); single rebuilder on swap (delta-aware warm x2, publishes only if generation still active); readers attach by reference (zero encodes); re-key fast path when delta empty (worker-only publications); FlatHybrid copy-on-write (thaw) on add_atom/remove_atom/_warm_delta; pooled arrays never mutated in place; numpy reads lock-free; opt-out TRACE_LITE_SHARED_WARM=0; telemetry in /api/status.shared_warm
r3.why: Per-thread GIL-bound FlatHybrid._warm_full re-encode serialized N threads into an N-fold storm (~11s @10k) starving every route segment; per-thread matrices also parked ~16MB RSS per zombie thread. One encode per generation + zero-copy attach removes both.

harness_3_workload.mutations: separate 120-op client at 1/s: 60 inserts + 40 edits over HTTP POST /api/ingest, 20 retractions via identical served remove_note code on a private WAL handle (no HTTP retract route exists; transport labeled per-op, never mislabeled)
harness_3_workload.targets: inserts mint mut-load-*.md; edits/retracts use high bench indices (>=64: parity sample + lifecycle doc safe); tiny-rung fallback onto same-plan mut docs
harness_3_workload.overlap: 2s status sampler (response-time labels, seeded first sample) tags every op; window/drain interval cross-check (proven_combined); overlap-only latency stats qualify under-drain evidence
harness_3_workload.records: offered vs achieved, e2e incl time-to-error with ok-only alongside, per-op [t,ms,ok] series, continuous in-window RSS (setup peak separate), hard 600s drain bound

residuals: S4 per-mutation catch-up (~0.75s @2k, worse @10k) saturates GIL under the .3 mutation stream -> sustained P95 seconds; needs cycle-2 R5 (no per-pass KMeans retrain). Latency bullets are informational (not hard gates).

S4 seed publish is one-shot with no busy retry: reproduced seed=failed 'database is locked' under write pressure; serving self-heals via open (servable=True, stale failed label) but first query-path materialize can thunder-herd. Cycle-2: retry/backoff + clear stale label.
